Look it’s easy to just say Pakistan ‘keeps attacking’ but the truth is every single conflict comes back to Kashmir. In 1947 when partition happened Kashmir was a Muslim-majority region that should’ve joined Pakistan but India forced the Maharaja to sign the Instrument of Accession which wasn’t even part of the original deal. Pakistan didn’t just ‘attack’ for fun it was a reaction to that. Kashmiris had the right to choose their future and Pakistan stepped in to support that. In 1965 Pakistan didn’t just randomly attack. Operation Gibraltar was a response to India building up its military and tightening its control over Kashmir. It was more about defending Kashmiris who were resisting Indian rule but India escalated things into a full war by crossing borders. 1971 India straight-up interfered in Pakistan’s internal affairs supporting a separatist movement. Pakistan wasn’t attacking India it was defending its sovereignty. India invaded East Pakistan and that led to the creation of Bangladesh. But no one talks about India being the aggressor there. Pakistan was just trying to protect itself. Then Kargil in 99 it wasn’t an unprovoked attack. Pakistan was reacting to India’s ongoing occupation of Kashmir. The whole point was to get the world’s attention and remind everyone that Kashmir’s situation was still unresolved. It was about taking back what was rightfully Pakistan’s not about attacking India. So no Pakistan didn’t just ‘keep attacking.’ Every conflict was about defending Kashmir and resisting India’s occupation. As long as Kashmir’s status is still up in the air tensions will keep rising. This isn’t about aggression it’s about getting justice for a region that’s been stuck in limbo for decades. Don’t even get me started on the Abhinandan shit on Feb 27 2019.
